celeste.name: Celeste Quill
celeste.greeting: There you are. Try not to look like a detective — the donors can smell suspicion.

topics.label: What exactly happened to the Glass Orchid?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: It stood on the Orchid Wing pedestal at closing. At dawn — gone. No alarm. No broken glass that matches Liora's formula.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: So either a ghost with excellent taste, or someone who knows this building better than the blueprints.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: Talk to the staff. Start with the pedestal. And Mira — Junior or Senior, don't skip the notebook. I taught you better.

topics.notebook: Case: Glass Orchid missing from locked pedestal. No matching shards. Investigate staff + pedestal.

topics.label: Tell me about Liora Finch

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: She bequeathed the sculpture to stay public. No private sale. Some patrons find that… inconvenient.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Inconvenient is my favorite kind of motive.

topics.label: Who had access last night?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: Rowan in the studio. Iris sometimes checks humidity after hours. Theo opens at dawn. Juliette Crane lingered after the donor toast.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: A tidy little suspect bouquet. How botanical of us.

topics.notebook: Access: Rowan (studio), Iris (after hours?), Theo (dawn), Juliette (after toast).

topics.label: I've found some things…

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Specialty scratch on the lock. Guestbook oddities. I'm collecting puzzle pieces like a raccoon with standards.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: Good. When the climate panel unlocks the altered log, come back. I'll share the badge admin fragment.

topics.label: Climate log is open — about that badge fragment?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: I hoped you wouldn't need this. Half of the atrium terminal password — the rest is the midnight ping you already saw.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You're trusting me with admin toys. Flattering. Mildly terrifying.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: Sort the badge timeline in the atrium office. And Mira — clear people before you condemn them.

topics.notebook: Celeste gave badge admin fragment. Sort the atrium badge log timeline.

topics.label: I recovered the Glass Orchid

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Hollow kiln brick. Intact. Your orphaned centerpiece misses its pedestal.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: Oh, Mira. Pin the proof on your board, then speak to Rowan. Justice — not spectacle.

topics.label: Case closed — how are you holding up?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: The gala contracts get rewritten. Juliette's private-sale pressure stops here. Rowan will make restitution — and teach apprentices about trust.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Liora's glass stays public. I'll take that as a win.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.text: You're always welcome in the Hollow. Suitcase optional.

iris.name: Dr. Iris Pembroke
iris.greeting: Mind the specimens. Some of them are older than our patience.

topics.label: Beautiful archive

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Beauty is just water, pressure, and time. Rather like secrets.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I'll try not to press anyone flat between blotters.

topics.label: You signed in at 23:40 last night

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Ah. The guestbook. Yes — blight sampling on the living Cattleya. Tissue swabs. Not… sculpture acquisition.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You understand how 'after midnight in the crime wing' looks.

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: I do. Check my lab notes if you must. And the humidity sheet on my desk — the panel's been temperamental.

topics.notebook: Iris claims after-hours visit was living-tissue blight sampling. Check humidity sheet.

topics.label: Could the orchid have been smashed?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Liora's batch has a refractive signature. The sweepings Celeste showed me don't match. Someone wants us to think it shattered.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Red herring, botanical edition.

topics.label: Help with the Latin bench tags?

lines.speaker: iris
lines.text: Bench 3 is Cattleya labiata — showy, fragrant, and frequently mislabeled by enthusiastic volunteers.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Educational side quest acquired. Thanks.

rowan.name: Rowan Vale
rowan.greeting: If you're here to accuse the artist, take a number. The kiln's hotter than the gossip.

topics.label: What tool leaves a crescent scratch?

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: Tungsten crescent pick. Delicate. Expensive. I keep one for latch work on display cases — when I'm authorized.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: And when you're not authorized?

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: Then I use my charm. Which, you'll notice, is also expensive.

topics.notebook: Rowan confirms tungsten crescent picks leave shallow scars — and that he owns one.

topics.label: There's glass dust on your boots

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: I work in a glass studio. If my boots were clean, you'd accuse me of never working.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Touché. Annoyingly valid.

topics.label: The kiln residue trail leads here

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: Residue? Look — Theo has debts. People do desperate things. Maybe check the shed before you UV my integrity.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Interesting pivot. I'll check everyone. Including pivots.

topics.notebook: Rowan tried to steer me toward Theo after the UV trail. Nervous tell.

topics.label: How do you feel about Liora's bequest?

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: Art should be seen. Not auctioned into a penthouse that never waters its plants.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: We agree. Which is why I'm curious who disagrees loudly.

topics.label: I have proof. You took the orchid.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Tungsten scratch. Midnight badge. Hollow kiln brick with the orchid still inside. You didn't smash it — you 'insured' it.

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: …Juliette was going to force a private sale. Break Liora's bequest. I moved it. Temporary. Then you got close and I — panicked. Planted the fragment toward Theo. That part I'm not proud of.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Protective theft plus framing. Creative. Still theft. Still a frame.

lines.speaker: rowan
lines.text: I'll return it properly. Restitution. Community service. Just… don't let them sell her work into a vault.

topics.notebook: Rowan confesses: protective theft to block Juliette's forced sale; panicked and framed Theo. Orchid recovered; restitution path.

theo.name: Theo Marsh
theo.greeting: Stay out of the mulch unless you're wearing boots you hate.

topics.label: Rough night for the grounds?

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Every night's rough if you listen to compost. What do you want, Quill?

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Answers. Preferably without pity speeches.

topics.label: I found your pawn slip

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Grandfather's watch. Gold case. My debt — my call. Not your glass flower.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I needed to hear you say it. Gambling stigma makes a convenient frame.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Whoever pointed you here wanted a neat villain. I oil hinges. I don't steal heirlooms.

topics.notebook: Theo cleared: pawned grandfather's watch for debts — not the orchid. Resents the pity angle.

topics.label: Any doors that only wake at night?

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Service door on the west wall squeaks after dark when the humidity drops. Crowbar lives behind it. Don't ask why.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I won't. I'll just borrow it heroically.

topics.notebook: Theo: night service door squeaks; crowbar stashed behind it. Switch to night at the cottage.

juliette.name: Juliette Crane
juliette.greeting: Mira Quill. You look like trouble in comfortable shoes.

topics.label: Enjoying the gala prep?

lines.speaker: juliette
lines.text: Champagne is easier than honesty. You're here about the orchid.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Among other expensive subjects.

topics.label: Your $80k private bid is in the ledger

lines.speaker: juliette
lines.text: …Fine. I wanted it. Celeste wouldn't sell. I scheduled a lawyer that night — divorce, not fencing. My alibi was ugly, not criminal.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Ugly alibis still clear smash-and-grab theories.

lines.speaker: juliette
lines.text: Pressure a bequest? Perhaps. Steal glass? Beneath me.

topics.notebook: Juliette cleared (partial): $80k bid real; night alibi was divorce lawyer, not fencing. Still pressured Celeste on sale.

topics.label: Any 'consulting gifts' I should refuse?

lines.speaker: juliette
lines.text: A retainer. Discreet. You look underpaid.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: I look ethical. Hard pass — integrity note filed.

topics.notebook: Refused Juliette's consulting gift. Integrity intact.

finn.name: Finn Hale
finn.greeting: Moss & Bean: coffee, canapés, and curated hearsay. First rumor's free.

topics.label: Got a rumor for a visiting sleuth?

lines.speaker: finn
lines.text: People say the orchid was smashed. People also say Victorian plumbing is charming. Both are lies with good branding.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: So follow the studio heat, not the broom closet.

topics.notebook: Finn: smash rumor is branding. Look at the studio, not the sweepings.

topics.label: I need a nudge

lines.speaker: finn
lines.text: Theo's debts are real; his guilt isn't. Juliette's perfume lingered near the lounge ledger. Rowan talks fastest when he's wrong.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You should bill the Conservatory as a consulting detective.

topics.notebook: Finn nudge: clear Theo's pawn, check Juliette's ledger, pressure Rowan's fast talk.

topics.label: Sharper nudge?

lines.speaker: finn
lines.text: Hollow bricks keep secrets. Night doors keep crowbars. Badge logs keep timestamps. You're welcome; the Fog Latte is not free.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Put it on Celeste's tab. She invited the chaos.

topics.notebook: Finn sharp: hollow kiln brick + night crowbar + badge timeline = accusation kit.

topics.label: Victorian plumbing monologue?

lines.speaker: finn
lines.text: The Conservatory pipes complain in G minor. Like donors. Anyway — solve your mystery before the canapés wilt.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Inspirational. Truly.
